title: Admin custom domain persistence and guidance

requirements.summary: Persist validated custom domain from the Admin Dashboard Domain tab and display the saved value.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Validate Domain" still validates using the existing `normalizeDomain` + `validateCustomDomain` logic.
If validation passes, the UI calls the backend to persist the domain and shows a success toast confirming it was saved.
The Domain tab displays the currently saved domain on load (and after saving) so the admin can confirm what is configured.
If the backend update fails (e.g., not authenticated), the UI shows an error toast and does not falsely indicate the domain was saved.

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for the custom domain backend capabilities: a query hook that retrieves the currently saved domain (via backend `getCustomDomain`) and a mutation hook to persist the domain (via backend `setCustomDomain`), invalidating/refetching the custom-domain query on success. Use the existing actor from `useActor` and handle authorization failures by surfacing errors to the caller. (Selected component: authorization — rely on the existing authenticated actor behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

Update the Domain tab to (1) load and display the currently saved domain using the new query hook, (2) keep the existing `normalizeDomain` + `validateCustomDomain` validation flow on "Validate Domain", and (3) on successful validation, call the new mutation hook to persist the normalized domain and show a success toast only after the save succeeds. If the save throws (e.g., authorization), show an error toast and keep UI state consistent (do not indicate the domain is saved; do not update any 'saved' display until the refetch reflects it). (Selected component: authorization — ensure calls are made with the authenticated actor and authorization errors are handled gracefully; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

requirements.summary: Add clear English-only guidance in the Admin Domain tab describing what the setting does and the manual steps required to use a custom domain.
acceptanceCriteria: The Domain tab includes a short, readable set of steps describing that purchasing/controlling the domain and configuring DNS is required.

The text explicitly mentions the current live address `uthaansewasamiti-1eg.caffeine.xyz` as the existing working URL and clarifies that saving a domain in the dashboard alone does not automatically change hosting.
All new user-facing guidance text is in English.

file_operations.description: In the Domain tab UI, add an English-only guidance section (do not wrap in the bilingual `t()` helper) explaining: what saving the custom domain does (stores a value for reference/config), that the current working URL is `uthaansewasamiti-1eg.caffeine.xyz` and will continue to work unless the custom domain is correctly pointed, and the required manual steps (own the domain, set DNS records, complete IC/boundary-node custom domain setup, then verify). Keep the copy short, readable, and clearly state that saving in the dashboard alone does not change hosting.
